name: Ossuary Reliquary

Traits.name: Withering Grave-Light
Traits.text: At the end of each of the reliquary's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the reliquary takes 13 (3d8) Radiant damage.
Traits.gmQuote: what is loyal and withers what is not
Traits.expresses: healing the loyal, withering the faithless

Traits.name: Ward Bond
Traits.text: The reliquary is magically bound to a ward of its choosing, and it can have only one ward at a time. While the reliquary is within 60 feet of its ward, half of any damage the ward takes (round up) is transferred to the reliquary.

Traits.name: Regeneration
Traits.text: The reliquary regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point. If the reliquary takes Necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the reliquary's next turn.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The reliquary makes two Relic Maul attacks.

Actions.name: Relic Maul
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 19 (4d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Warding Aegis (2/Day)
Actions.text: The reliquary targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target gains 33 (6d10) Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the reliquary's next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Saint's Vigor (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The reliquary touches a creature within 5 feet of itself and restores 33 (6d10) Hit Points to it.

Reactions.name: Interpose
Reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature within 5 feet of the reliquary that it guards is hit by an attack roll. *Response:* The attack hits the reliquary instead, and the reliquary has Resistance to the attack's damage.

lore: Forged from the gilded bones and iron casing of a martyred saint, the reliquary endures as a tomb-bound guardian that cannot rest until the last pilgrim it was sworn to protect has passed beyond the world.

generation.userConcept: a saint's reliquary that heals what is loyal and withers what is not
generation.cite: composition after Shield Guardian (CR 7) — Bound transfer, Regeneration, the measured 0.65 damage discount

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a saint's reliquary that heals what is loyal and withers what is not
